crusadecraft.colony.no_town: No built city here: stand in a city placed with the Architect's Plan or built by the editor.
crusadecraft.colony.denied: Only creative mode, the map editor or the realm holding this city can make it a colony.
crusadecraft.colony.no_minecolonies: MineColonies does not answer: no colony can be founded.
crusadecraft.colony.not_finished: The city is still being placed: wait for the bar to finish.
crusadecraft.colony.already_ruler: You already rule %s: choose "Make it my colony" instead, it will join your realm.
crusadecraft.colony.no_town_hall: This city has no MineColonies town hall: it cannot become a colony.
crusadecraft.colony.refused: MineColonies refused the colony: the town hall may already lie inside another colony.
crusadecraft.colony.joined: %s becomes a colony of %s buildings and joins %s. Colonists will arrive.
crusadecraft.colony.made: %s becomes your colony, with %s buildings registered. Colonists will arrive.
crusadecraft.colony.founding: %s becomes your colony, with %s buildings. Now choose your realm's name.
crusadecraft.colony.offer.colony.tip: A real MineColonies colony: every building is registered at its level, colonists arrive and work there. It joins your realm if you have one.
crusadecraft.colony.offer.realm.tip: The city becomes your colony, then the capital of the realm you found: the founding screen opens at once.
crusadecraft.plan.frozen: Ghost frozen at %s, %s, %s: walk around, adjust, then right-click to place.
crusadecraft.plan.unfrozen: Ghost released: it follows your crosshair again.
crusadecraft.plan.too_far: Too far to place: come closer (160 blocks at most).
crusadecraft.plan.hud.hint.place: Right-click: place where the ghost is
crusadecraft.plan.hud.hint.freeze: G: freeze or release · Home: reset
crusadecraft.plan.hud.hint.catalog: Right-click at the sky: the catalogue
crusadecraft.plan.tooltip.1: Right-click at the sky: the catalogue
crusadecraft.plan.tooltip.2: Right-click: place where the ghost is
